class.name: SuperposWorld
class.brief_description: EGP scene owner for a native Superpos session.
class.description: Compiled into the EGP engine through its native Superpos module. Full-width unsigned values use signed opaque Variant bits in GDScript and unsigned native metadata in generated C# and C++ bindings.

method.name: advance_tick
method.description: Advances the canonical session by one tick on its owning thread. For a world with automatic ticks enabled, manual advancement is rejected.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the session through [method close_checked]. Use the checked method when the caller needs the rejection reason.

method.name: close_checked
method.description: Closes the owned canonical world and transport, subject to owner and lifecycle checks. Retained wrappers cannot revive an owner that has been permanently retired.

method.name: configure
method.description: Creates and owns a native session using the authored schema, capacity and authority properties. An existing attached session must be closed first. This does not configure UDP admission.

method.name: get_session
method.description: Returns the attached session, or null when owner validation fails or no session is attached. Use [method read_session] to inspect the checked error.

method.name: read_configuration
method.description: Returns a checked Dictionary of authored schemas, maximum objects, authority epoch, authority peer and automatic tick settings. Authored authority properties are not proof of live authenticated authority.

method.name: read_session
method.description: Returns a Dictionary containing error and, only on success, value with the attached session. Access and lifetime follow the main-thread world owner.

members.member: Authored unsigned authority epoch for the next configuration. Use the session checked authority read for live state.
Authored unsigned authority peer identity for the next configuration. This property does not contain credentials or establish network admission.
When enabled, the owned session advances through this Node physics processing and rejects manual tick advancement. This does not register a physics simulation provider.
Maximum canonical object capacity used when configuring the next owned session.
Schemas used when configuring the next owned session. Editing authored configuration does not silently reconfigure a live session.
